Chartered Accountant
+91 8733018407
shakshirajput7043@gmail.com 
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ca-shakshi-rajput-44950b21b/
SUMMARY
Chartered Accountant (Jan 2026) with 36 months of 
articleship experience in taxation and audit. Proficient 
in GST compliance, income tax filings, TDS returns, 
and statutory audit support. Experienced in handling 
multiple clients, preparing tax computations, and 
ensuring regulatory compliance with strong analytical 
and problem-solving skills.
EDUCATION
Chartered Accountant  303/600   
Institute of Chartered Accountant Of India
Exemption in IBS And Advance Financial Management 
Subjects
B.COM                                                                267/490
D.R. Patel & R.B. Patel Commerce College
12TH                                                                          537/750
Vidya Bharti School
10TH                                                                               369/500
Seventh Day Adventist High School
AWARDS AND CERTIFICATIONS
MS Excel Certification Course
Udemy.
PROFESSIONAL SKILLS
Financial Accounting &Reporting.
Indirect Taxation-Goods and Service Tax Compliance &
Return Filing.
MS Excel & Data Analysis.
Accounting Software Handling .
Problem Solving &Analytical Skills.
Direct Taxation
SOFTWARE SKILLS
Microsoft Excel /Microsoft Word/Microsoft Power 
point.
Gen GST Software.  
 Genius.
Tally.
EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
Certificates for various Athletic Events  in School.
Gardening and plant care as a hobby promoting 
creativity and stress management.
LANGUAGE
English, Hindi, Gujarati
EXPERIENCE
Articleship Trainee     36 Months
Abhishek Verma & Co
A boutique firm in Surat having more than 250+ client offering 
personalized tax planning and financial services.
:
 Executed statutory audit assignments, including designing 
audit programs and evaluating compliance with Ind AS 12 
(DTA recognition) and Ind AS 24 (related party disclosures).
 Reviewed financial statements and ensured compliance 
with Schedule III and applicable Ind AS requirements, 
including depreciation and accounting policies.
	 Evaluated Internal Financial Controls (IFC), identified 
control gaps, and recommended actionable improvements.
	 Performed substantive and analytical procedures, including 
ledger scrutiny, vouching, and verification of financial 
transactions.
	 Drafted audit reports in accordance with SA 700, SA 705, and 
SA 706, and supported reporting under CARO, 2020.
	 Verified provisions and contingent liabilities in line with Ind 
AS 37 and analysed disclosures such as capital commitments 
and bank guarantees.
	 Obtained management representation letters and 
documented key audit observations and conclusions.
	 Coordinated with client teams to resolve audit queries and 
ensure timely completion of assignments.
	 Assisted in statutory audits across sectors including 
manufacturing, textiles, and trading.
	 Conducted tax audits (Section 44AB) for clients with turnover 
exceeding ₹5 crores and prepared Form 3CD.
	 Computed advance tax liabilities and ensured compliance 
with Income-tax provisions.
	 Prepared audit working papers, performed balance sheet 
reconciliations, and reviewed general ledger and sub-ledger 
transactions.
	 Advised clients on process automation and access controls to 
prevent unauthorized payments.
	 Worked on audit engagements for clients including 
Laxminathjee Silk Mills Pvt Ltd.

	Assisted in GST compliance, including preparation and filing 
of returns such as GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and GSTR-9.
	Reconciled GSTR-2A/2B with purchase register to ensure 
accurate Input Tax Credit (ITC) claims.
	Identified ineligible ITC and ensured compliance with GST 
provisions.
	 Assisted in GST audits and departmental notices, including 
preparation of replies and supporting documentation.
	 Analysed applicability of GST on various transactions, 
including classification, valuation, and place of supply.
	 Prepared GST workings and ensured timely payment of tax 
liabilities.
	 Assisted clients in GST registration, amendments, and 
cancellation processes.
	 Coordinated with clients to resolve GST-related queries and 
notices.
